list.name: keyword
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT keyword FROM ra_t_services WHERE keyword IS NOT NULL AND keyword <> '' ORDER BY keyword

targets.rawSql: SELECT o.start_date::timestamp AS time, o.nb::double precision AS occ, COALESCE(m.nb, 0)::double precision AS mmg FROM ( SELECT start_date, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM ra_t_occ_cdr_detail WHERE start_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY start_date ) o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT start_date, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM ra_t_mmg_cdr_det WHERE start_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY start_date ) m ON m.start_date = o.start_date ORDER BY time

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charge_amount),0)::double precision AS revenue_dt FROM ra_t_occ_cdr_detail WHERE start_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (${keyword:sqlstring} = '$__all' OR keyword = ${keyword:sqlstring})
SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS open_alerts FROM ra_t_alerts WHERE status = false
SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS nb FROM ra_t_mmg_occ_ecart WHERE alerte = true

SELECT COALESCE(keyword, '(none)') AS keyword, SUM(charge_amount)::double precision AS revenue_dt FROM ra_t_occ_cdr_detail WHERE start_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY revenue_dt DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT start_date, nom_service, keyword, seuil_pct, count_nb_sms, motif FROM ra_t_alerts WHERE status = false ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20
